purpose: One information change: TRAIN-only pitcher-ID embedding (export column `pitcher`, never read by a direct-head model before) added to the frozen periodic_residual_counts arm. Descriptive repeated-DEV NLL/Brier only; no policy, RL, OPE or service claim.
source_configs: configs/EXP-P36-001.json (arm periodic_residual_counts copied verbatim, export manifest and training budget)

export.normalization: none learned here; arrays are the frozen EXP-P4-001 TRAIN-fitted transforms (parent preparation pinned)
export.context_layout_source: export manifest lineage.context_layout (SequenceContext.report features, Archetypes.report style/reliability columns and n_clusters, SharingContext clusters columns); names via direct_frontier_registry.direct_context_names; grouped labels map to names only through these source equivalences

seed_rule: only EXP-P38-001 may use seeds 44-48, fixed before any P38 output; disjoint from every registered config seed 0-38 (audit 2026-10-05 over all worktree configs) and the P37 DRAFT 39-43. New model randomness only, not new data.

pitcher_id.vocabulary: TRAIN split `pitcher` array only (labels not read); ids with >= 100 TRAIN rows sorted ascending; all other ids -> UNK 0 in every split
pitcher_id.index_column: appended after the workload column as the last context column (float32 exact integer), stripped by the network before the registered raw/continuous maps
pitcher_id.init: id table zeros, projection from a private generator seeded seed+7919: the untrained network equals the baseline at the same seed (CPU test)

contrasts.name: pitcher_id_vs_periodic_residual_counts
contrasts.isolates: pitcher identity information plus its embedding parameters (not separable, see capacity_note)

comparison.report: every seed and both splits (dev Cpanel, mlb_dev) as paired same-seed differences with game-cluster bootstrap 95% CI; also the UNK-row and in-vocabulary-row subsets of each split; no winner field
comparison.positive_criterion: mlb_dev and dev paired dNLL CI both below 0 and >= 4/5 seeds negative on each split: report as "pitcher ID adds information on repeated DEV" (exploratory, not adoption)
comparison.negative_criterion: either split CI includes 0 or is above 0: report as "no evidence pitcher ID adds information beyond profile/support context"; close the axis for the direct head
comparison.practical_floor: -0.003 NLL (D118 minimum effect) is quoted next to the result; crossing it is still not adoption
comparison.capacity_note: Candidate adds (n_vocab + 1) x 8 + 128 x 8 parameters (n_vocab unmeasured). No parameter-matched control is registered: an all-UNK arm adds one learned bias vector and is near-identical to the baseline; a hashed many-to-one map still carries identity; a one-to-one permutation is the same information. The parameter increase is therefore disclosed as part of the treatment, not removed.

exposure: DEV / MLB DEV are the same repeatedly exposed <=2025 rows (P24-P37). Designed after reading P24-P36 reports (post-selection). Exploratory only, not an independent test, no promotion. No 2026 data.
data_rules: No 2026 rows (exporter guard_dates + per-split year check; runner rechecks manifest). DEV/mlb_dev only predicted, never used for fit, robust-scale statistics, early stop, temperature or selection. Same export manifest as EXP-P35-001 (P24-P35 export). Pitcher vocabulary and counts from TRAIN rows only (date <= 20250430 checked); DEV-only or rare pitchers fall back to UNK.

blocked_until: runner/scorer/queue wiring on the P37 final lineage
